We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Apartment Manager
Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The Apartment Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operations, maintenance, and administration of the residential apartment property, ensuring a high standard of tenant satisfaction, optimal occupancy, and efficient facility management, while maximizing rental income and controlling operating costs.


Key Responsibilities


	Oversee daily operations of the apartment complex, including leasing, maintenance, and tenant relations.
	Market and advertise vacant units to maintain high occupancy rates.
	Screen prospective tenants, prepare lease agreements, and manage move-in/move-out processes.
	Collect rent and other charges, and follow up on outstanding payments.
	Coordinate routine maintenance, repairs, and inspections with technicians and vendors.
	Respond promptly to tenant complaints, requests, and emergencies.
	Ensure compliance with health, safety, and building regulations.
	Manage the property budget, control expenses, and prepare monthly financial and occupancy reports.
	Supervise on-site staff such as security, cleaners, and maintenance personnel.
	Maintain accurate tenant records and lease documentation.


Qualifications &amp; Experience


	Possess a Bachelor&#39;s Degree / HND in Estate Management, Business Administration, or related field with 3 - 5 years of experience in property / apartment or facility management.
	Knowledge of tenancy laws and property management best practices.

Apartment Manager Job at Tribest Corporate Support Limited




        
    

        
        Tribest is a corporate support solutions provider with a comprehensive range of people outsourcing services. We have a diversified team of management, strategy, banking and capacity development experts working together to provide organizations with the best human resource management solutions. With a team that diverse, we are setting new standards of performance and raising the bar in excellent service delivery.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Apartment Manager
Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The Apartment Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operations, maintenance, and administration of the residential apartment property, ensuring a high standard of tenant satisfaction, optimal occupancy, and efficient facility management, while maximizing rental income and controlling operating costs.


Key Responsibilities


	Oversee daily operations of the apartment complex, including leasing, maintenance, and tenant relations.
	Market and advertise vacant units to maintain high occupancy rates.
	Screen prospective tenants, prepare lease agreements, and manage move-in/move-out processes.
	Collect rent and other charges, and follow up on outstanding payments.
	Coordinate routine maintenance, repairs, and inspections with technicians and vendors.
	Respond promptly to tenant complaints, requests, and emergencies.
	Ensure compliance with health, safety, and building regulations.
	Manage the property budget, control expenses, and prepare monthly financial and occupancy reports.
	Supervise on-site staff such as security, cleaners, and maintenance personnel.
	Maintain accurate tenant records and lease documentation.


Qualifications & Experience


	Possess a Bachelor's Degree / HND in Estate Management, Business Administration, or related field with 3 - 5 years of experience in property / apartment or facility management.
	Knowledge of tenancy laws and property management best practices.

About the Role


	The SHEC &amp; Public Relations Manager will be responsible for implementing and managing project-wide Health, Safety, Environment, Community, and Public Relations programs in compliance with company standards, statutory requirements, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards, and international best practices.
	The successful candidate will play a key role in fostering a strong safety culture, maintaining positive community relations, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting sustainable mining operations.


Key Responsibilities
Safety Culture &amp; Community Engagement:


	Develop and implement HSE procedures, policies, and management systems.
	Drive safety awareness initiatives including toolbox talks, inductions, and training programs.
	Build and maintain positive relationships with host communities and stakeholders.
	Coordinate community engagement activities and grievance management processes.
	Support community development projects and stakeholder consultations.


Compliance &amp; Audits:


	Conduct regular SHEC inspections and audits.
	Ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and industry standards.
	Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual SHEC &amp; PR reports.
	Coordinate external audits and regulatory inspections.


Risk Management &amp; Emergency Response:


	Lead hazard identification and risk assessment programs.
	Investigate incidents, accidents, and near misses, including root cause analysis.
	Implement effective corrective and preventive actions.
	Develop and test emergency preparedness and response plans.
	Ensure functional firefighting and emergency response capabilities on site.


Requirements
Education &amp; Certifications:


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in&nbsp;Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Administration, or a related discipline.
	Professional HSE certifications such as NEBOSH, IOSH, CSP, WSO, IEMA, or equivalent.
	Nigerian safety professional certifications will be considered an added advantage.


Experience:


	6-10 years of experience in Health, Safety, Environment, and Public Relations within mining or heavy industrial operations.
	Experience in underground coal mining (adit/tunnel) is highly desirable. Open-pit mining experience will also be considered.
	Proven experience implementing and maintaining ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems.
	Experience managing community relations, stakeholder engagement, and community development projects.
	Experience conducting HSE audits, incident investigations, risk assessments, and compliance evaluations.

	Excellent reporting, documentation, and analytical skills.

	Fluency in English and a local Kogi State dialect is highly desirable.
	High level of integrity, professionalism, honesty, and commitment.


Why Join Us?


	This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a growing mining operation while driving excellence in safety, environmental stewardship, community relations, and regulatory compliance.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: ogbonn.gift@africanindustries.com using &quot;Application for SHEC &amp; Public Relations Manager&quot; as the subject of the email.

SHEC & Public Relations Manager Job at Bretty Consultancy Services




        
    

        
        Bretty Consultancy Services, an Human Resource and Business consultancy firm, is recruiting suitably experienced and results-driven candidates to join our team at our mining operations, in the capacity below:

 Job Position: SHEC & Public Relations Manager

Job Location: Ankpa, Kogi
Employment Type: Full-time
Department: SHEC & ESG
Reports To: SHEC & ESG Head
Supervises: H&S Officers, H&S Assistant, ERT Team

About the Role
     

            
    




	The SHEC & Public Relations Manager will be responsible for implementing and managing project-wide Health, Safety, Environment, Community, and Public Relations programs in compliance with company standards, statutory requirements, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards, and international best practices.
	The successful candidate will play a key role in fostering a strong safety culture, maintaining positive community relations, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting sustainable mining operations.


Key Responsibilities
Safety Culture & Community Engagement:


	Develop and implement HSE procedures, policies, and management systems.
	Drive safety awareness initiatives including toolbox talks, inductions, and training programs.
	Build and maintain positive relationships with host communities and stakeholders.
	Coordinate community engagement activities and grievance management processes.
	Support community development projects and stakeholder consultations.


Compliance & Audits:


	Conduct regular SHEC inspections and audits.
	Ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and industry standards.
	Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual SHEC & PR reports.
	Coordinate external audits and regulatory inspections.


Risk Management & Emergency Response:


	Lead hazard identification and risk assessment programs.
	Investigate incidents, accidents, and near misses, including root cause analysis.
	Implement effective corrective and preventive actions.
	Develop and test emergency preparedness and response plans.
	Ensure functional firefighting and emergency response capabilities on site.


Requirements
Education & Certifications:


	Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Administration, or a related discipline.
	Professional HSE certifications such as NEBOSH, IOSH, CSP, WSO, IEMA, or equivalent.
	Nigerian safety professional certifications will be considered an added advantage.


Experience:


	6-10 years of experience in Health, Safety, Environment, and Public Relations within mining or heavy industrial operations.
	Experience in underground coal mining (adit/tunnel) is highly desirable. Open-pit mining experience will also be considered.
	Proven experience implementing and maintaining ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems.
	Experience managing community relations, stakeholder engagement, and community development projects.
	Experience conducting HSE audits, incident investigations, risk assessments, and compliance evaluations.


Skills & Competencies:


	Excellent reporting, documentation, and analytical skills.
	Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
	Good presentation and training delivery skills.
	Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.
	Strong understanding of environmental and occupational health & safety management systems.
	Fluency in English and a local Kogi State dialect is highly desirable.
	High level of integrity, professionalism, honesty, and commitment.


Why Join Us?


	This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a growing mining operation while driving excellence in safety, environmental stewardship, community relations, and regulatory compliance.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Application for SHEC & Public Relations Manager" as the subject of the email.

Note: We are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a safe, inclusive, and productive work environment.

  "title": "Compliance Officer",
  "description": "Bretty&nbsp;Consultancy Services, an HR and&nbsp;Business consultancy firm, is&nbsp;recruiting suitably qualified candidates to fill the position below:&nbsp;

Job Position: Compliance Officer
Job Location: Agbara, Ogun
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Compliance Officer to join our team in Agbara, Ogun State. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that the plant operates in full compliance with all applicable statutory, regulatory, and internal company requirements.
	The role will support the organization&#39;s regulatory governance framework through timely statutory filings, maintenance of compliance records, liaison with regulatory authorities, compliance monitoring, and advisory support to management on regulatory obligations.
	The ideal candidate will play a key role in minimizing legal, operational, and reputational risks while promoting a strong culture of compliance across the organization.


Key Responsibilities


	Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws, regulations, and industry standards.
	Monitor changes in regulatory requirements and advise management and relevant departments on potential business impacts.
	Coordinate and facilitate timely statutory filings, licence renewals, permit applications, and regulatory submissions.
	Serve as the primary point of contact with government agencies and regulatory bodies, including but not limited to:
	
		National Environmental Standards and Regulations Enforcement Agency (NESREA)
		Standards Organisation of Nigeria (SON)
		National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC), where applicable
		Fire Service and other relevant regulatory authorities
	
	
	Maintain up-to-date compliance registers, statutory records, licences, permits, and certifications.
	Conduct periodic compliance reviews and audits to identify potential gaps and recommend corrective actions.
	Develop, implement, and monitor compliance checklists to ensure adherence to statutory and internal policy requirements.
	Support internal and external audits by providing necessary documentation and coordinating responses to audit findings.
	Prepare and present periodic compliance reports to management.
	Investigate compliance-related issues and recommend preventive and corrective measures.
	Collaborate with HR, Finance, Operations, Legal, Procurement, HSE, and other departments to ensure regulatory compliance across all business functions.
	Coordinate compliance awareness programs and educate employees on regulatory obligations and company policies.
	Maintain proper documentation relating to inspections, regulatory visits, correspondence, and compliance activities.
	Track and ensure timely closure of regulatory observations, audit findings, and compliance action plans.
	Perform other compliance-related duties as assigned by management.


Qualifications


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or Higher National Diploma (HND) in Law, Business Administration, Accounting, Public Administration, Political Science, Industrial Relations, or any related discipline.
	Professional certification in Compliance, Risk Management, Internal Audit, Corporate Governance, or related fields will be an added advantage.
	Membership of relevant professional bodies is desirable.


Experience:


	5-10 years of relevant experience in Compliance, Internal Audit, Risk Management, Corporate Governance, Regulatory Affairs, or Legal Compliance.
	Prior experience within a manufacturing or chemical industry environment is highly preferred.
	Experience liaising directly with government agencies and regulatory bodies is a significant advantage.


Required Skills &amp; Competencies:


	Strong knowledge of Nigerian statutory and regulatory requirements.
	Excellent understanding of corporate governance principles and compliance frameworks.
	Sound knowledge of compliance monitoring, risk assessment, and regulatory reporting methodologies.
	Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
	Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.
	High level of integrity, professionalism, and attention to detail.
	Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively.


Salary
Negotiable

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their CV to: Recruitment.Agbara@Africanindustries.com using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.&nbsp;",
